verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart says teams can "work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform". It also documents selecting an audit partner and validating evidence before audit submission, which supports in-platform auditor collaboration in place of emailed PDFs. However, the evidence is marketing-level, with no documentation of a dedicated scoped auditor role or view. Missing for 10: documented scoped/read-only auditor access to controls and evidence, details of the auditor workspace (comments, evidence requests, sign-off), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
